_comment_socks_auth: Optional: require SOCKS5 username/password (RFC 1929). Both fields must be set together or both omitted.
_comment_adaptive_polling: Optional: adaptive polling drops the poll interval to sleep_step_ms if the client is completely idle for idle_timeout_ms. Prevents quota exhaustion.
_comment_coalesce: Optional: adaptive uplink coalescing. Set coalesce_step_ms to a positive number to make a burst of TX operations wait a little for more operations before sending, which reduces Apps Script calls. A good starting range is 20-40 ms. Set it to 0 to turn coalescing off.
_comment_idle_slots: Optional download-throughput tuning. Default 1 (safe). Raise to 2 if each account has 2+ deployments — this may increase download throughput; leave at 1 for accounts with one deployment. Max 3. Omitting the field is equivalent to 1.
_comment_jitter: Optional: cryptographic jitter bounds (ms) to disrupt traffic correlation. Requires math/big and crypto/rand to ensure cryptographic safety.
_comment_workers: Optional: global limit for concurrent Zstd and AES operations. 0 = auto-scale based on runtime.NumCPU() * 8.
_comment_max_active_sessions: Optional: Max concurrent sessions. 0 = auto scale. -1 = infinite / disable protection.
_comment_flush_size_kb: Optional: Threshold in KB to immediately flush the TX buffer. Default: 128.
_comment_idle_session_timeout_ms: Optional: Time in milliseconds of zero RX/TX activity before an idle session is forcefully reaped. Default: 60000.
